about: Golf-sense questions for CoachHelm chat. Each question says what a correct answer must state (facts), must not state (forbid), and which reads it should use (readers; an empty list means it can be answered from the prompt or the reference). Placeholders in braces are filled from the staging roster by the harness: {player}, {player2} (two active players with rounds), {new_player} (a player with fewer than three shot-tracked rounds), {no_shots_player} (a player with hole-by-hole rounds and no logged shots), {teammate} (for a player's turn: any other player on the team). A fact is a phrase the answer must match; these questions test meaning and direction, so no figure is expected here (the data questions in scripts/coachhelm/ask-eval.mjs check figures). Every question is also scored against the patterns named in global_forbid (the writing rules: no n= notation, no heading or table, no abbreviation a coach would not say aloud, sentence-case stat names with Tour capitalised, a capital at the start of every sentence, proper nouns as they are written and names as the team's records have them, a distance in words (feet, yards), no tool or table name). A question with style.max_sentences fails when the answer runs longer.

names_pga_unprompted.why: Names the PGA Tour when no read named a tour. The harness skips this for a men's team whose standards read named it; for a women's team it always applies.

sign_as_verdict.why: Reads the sign of a strokes gained figure as a verdict.

estimate_as_tour_gap.why: Treats a scorecard estimate as a measured gap to the Tour.

sample_notation.why: The sample written as notation (n=4, N-4, (n 4), a bare count in brackets). Say it in words: over 4 rounds.

heading_or_table.why: A heading (markdown, bold line, ALL CAPS or Title Case), a bold label at the start of a line or list item ("- **Overall:** ..."), or a table. An answer is a few plain sentences.

abbreviation.why: An abbreviation a coach would not say aloud (SG, GIR, avg, vs, yds, ft, L10). Write strokes gained, greens in regulation, average, against, last 10 rounds, and a distance in words: from 3 to 5 feet, inside 10 feet, 281 yards.

wrong_case.re: Strokes Gained|Greens [Ii]n Regulation|Scoring Average|Fairways Hit|Putts Per Round|Make Rate|Off [Tt]he Tee|Around [Tt]he Green|\b(?:the|against|PGA|LPGA) tour\b
wrong_case.why: Capitalisation: stats are sentence case (strokes gained, greens in regulation) and Tour is capitalised.

sentence_start_case.why: A sentence or a list line that starts with a lower-case letter.

proper_noun_case.why: A proper noun not capitalised as it is written: PGA Tour, LPGA Tour, NCAA, Division I, and a player's, course's or event's name exactly as the team's records have it. The harness adds the team's own names (see properNounPattern).

ascii_minus.why: A hyphen for a minus sign (-0.31). The reads give a real minus sign (−0.31): copy the figure as it is.

numeric_date.why: A date as digits (2026-05-18, 5/18/26). Say it as a coach would: 18 May, between 18 May and 21 October.
